newsitem.title: BOSNIA: U.N. policeman wounded in Bosnia grenade incident.
newsitem.headline: U.N. policeman wounded in Bosnia grenade incident.

text.p: A United Nations police station commmander and his interpreter were wounded when a hand grenade was thrown into their car between Nevisinje and Mostar in southwestern Bosnia, a U.N. spokesman said on Saturday.
"The station commander and his interepreter were able to stop the car and jump out," said Alex Ivanko, U.N. police spokesman in Sarajevo.
"That's why they sustained only minimal injuries in the attack."
Ivanko said the two casualties from Friday's incident were being treated at a French military hospital in Mostar. An investigation was under way.
